presetDetail.name: cascade-claude
presetDetail.description: The default team since 2026-11-14: the routing cascade (F80 to F99) on Claude models only, one Claude plan (measured in evals/routing-bench). Grunt: Claude Haiku 5.5 low, gated only by checks. Worker: Haiku 5.5 high. Senior: Claude Sonnet 5.5 high. Tester: Sonnet 5.5 high. Expert: Claude Opus 5.5 medium, which plans and writes blueprints and builds nothing. No spec writer, so the expert is called only when Tier 0 or an escalation asks for it. Efforts raised from medium on 2026-11-17 (STATUS 63): on batch 3 solo Haiku at high passed 8 of 10 and this preset at medium 7 of 10, with Sonnet at medium thinking about 1k tokens a turn against Haiku high's 25k.
